name: wardogs-frontline
description: Wardogs Frontline: fan-made community season war for WARDOGS. Not affiliated with Bulkhead or Team17.

scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm --filter @frontline/functions build && pnpm --filter @frontline/web build:dev && pnpm --filter @frontline/web verify:dev && firebase deploy --project dev --force --only "hosting,firestore,functions:onIntegrationEvent,functions:advanceWarJob,functions:simulateWarJob,functions:fastForwardDemo"
scripts.deploy:dev:web: pnpm --filter @frontline/web build:dev && pnpm --filter @frontline/web verify:dev && firebase deploy --project dev --only hosting
